name: Put
overview: Put is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Ham, as recorded in Genesis 10:6. Beyond this genealogical note, no additional tribal affiliation or personal details are provided in the biblical text. His mention situates him within the broader context of the descendants of Noah following the Flood.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Put' appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:6. No specific meaning or divine origin is attributed to the name in the biblical record, and thus it is presented simply as a personal designation without further explanation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Put as a son of Ham, establishing a direct filial relationship in the genealogical account of Genesis 10:6. No other family relationships or tribal affiliations are documented for Put in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Put's significance lies primarily in his role as part of the genealogical lineage descending from Ham, one of Noah's sons. This lineage is foundational for understanding the distribution of peoples and nations after the Flood, as recorded in Genesis. While details about Put's descendants or specific actions are not given, his inclusion underscores the biblical emphasis on the origins of nations through Noah's family.
